THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
SCULPTED DRAMA
022
26 / Feather Back
A close, over-the-shoulder beauty portrait with long
black hair, a black draped backless garment with a feathered
shoulder detail, a fine gold chain and a pale mint-gray backdrop.
The glance towards the camera is soft but intense.
27 / Studio Knot
A frontal beauty portrait with a loose messy top knot, soft
face-framing strands, faint freckles, a natural pink-coral lip and a
simple black knit sweater. Gradient gray-blue studio background.
